verses.en: Now concerning the things whereof ye wrote unto me: It is good for a man not to touch a woman.
verses.pt: Ora, quanto às coisas de que me escrevestes, bom seria que o homem não tocasse em mulher;
verses.en_web: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.
verses.en_bbe: Now, as to the things in your letter to me: It is good for a man to have nothing to do with a woman.

verses.en: Nevertheless, to avoid fornication, let every man have his own wife, and let every woman have her own husband.
verses.pt: mas, por causa da prostituição, tenha cada homem sua própria mulher e cada mulher seu próprio marido.
verses.en_web: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.
verses.en_bbe: But because of the desires of the flesh, let every man have his wife, and every woman her husband.

verses.en: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence: and likewise also the wife unto the husband.
verses.pt: O marido pague à mulher o que lhe é devido, e do mesmo modo a mulher ao marido.
verses.en_web: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.
verses.en_bbe: Let the husband give to the wife what is right; and let the wife do the same to the husband.

verses.en: The wife hath not power of her own body, but the husband: and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body, but the wife.
verses.pt: A mulher não tem autoridade sobre o seu próprio corpo, mas sim o marido; e também da mesma sorte o marido não tem autoridade sobre o seu próprio corpo, mas sim a mulher.
verses.en_web: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife.
verses.en_bbe: The wife has not power over her body, but the husband; and in the same way the husband has not power over his body, but the wife.

verses.en: Defraud ye not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.
verses.pt: Não vos negueis um ao outro, senão de comum acordo por algum tempo, a fim de vos aplicardes à oração e depois vos ajuntardes outra vez, para que Satanás não vos tente pela vossa incontinência.
verses.en_web: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
verses.en_bbe: Do not keep back from one another what is right, but only for a short time, and by agreement, so that you may give yourselves to prayer, and come together again; so that Satan may not get the better of you through your loss of self-control.

verses.en: But I speak this by permission, and not of commandment.
verses.pt: Digo isto, porém, como que por concessão e não por mandamento.
verses.en_web: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.
verses.en_bbe: But this I say as my opinion, and not as an order of the Lord.

verses.en: For I would that all men were even as I myself. But every man hath his proper gift of God, one after this manner, and another after that.
verses.pt: Contudo queria que todos os homens fossem como eu mesmo; mas cada um tem de Deus o seu próprio dom, um deste modo, e outro daquele.
verses.en_web: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.
verses.en_bbe: It is my desire that all men might be even as I am. But every man has the power of his special way of life given him by God, one in this way and one in that.

verses.en: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.
verses.pt: Digo, porém, aos solteiros e às viúvas, que lhes é bom se ficarem como eu.
verses.en_web: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.
verses.en_bbe: But I say to the unmarried and to the widows, It is good for them to be even as I am.

verses.en: But if they cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.
verses.pt: Mas, se não podem conter-se, casem-se. Porque é melhor casar do que abrasar-se.
verses.en_web: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn.
verses.en_bbe: But if they have not self-control let them get married; for married life is better than the burning of desire.

verses.en: And unto the married I command, yet not I, but the Lord, Let not the wife depart from her husband:
verses.pt: Todavia, aos casados, mando, não eu mas o Senhor, que a mulher não se aparte do marido;
verses.en_web: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband
verses.en_bbe: But to the married I give orders, though not I but the Lord, that the wife may not go away from her husband

verses.en: But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband: and let not the husband put away his wife.
verses.pt: se, porém, se apartar, que fique sem casar, ou se reconcilie com o marido; e que o marido não deixe a mulher.
verses.en_web: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.
verses.en_bbe: (Or if she goes away from him, let her keep unmarried, or be united to her husband again); and that the husband may not go away from his wife.

verses.en: But to the rest speak I, not the Lord: If any brother hath a wife that believeth not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.
verses.pt: Mas aos outros digo eu, não o Senhor: Se algum irmão tem mulher incrédula, e ela consente em habitar com ele, não se separe dela.
verses.en_web: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.
verses.en_bbe: But to the rest I say, and not the Lord; If a brother has a wife who is not a Christian, and it is her desire to go on living with him, let him not go away from her.

verses.en: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not, and if he be pleased to dwell with her, let her not leave him.
verses.pt: E se alguma mulher tem marido incrédulo, e ele consente em habitar com ela, não se separe dele.
verses.en_web: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.
verses.en_bbe: And if a woman has a husband who is not a Christian, and it is his desire to go on living with her, let her not go away from her husband.

verses.en: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy.
verses.pt: Porque o marido incrédulo é santificado pela mulher, e a mulher incrédula é santificada pelo marido crente; de outro modo, os vossos filhos seriam imundos; mas agora são santos.
verses.en_web: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
verses.en_bbe: For the husband who has not faith is made holy through his Christian wife, and the wife who is not a Christian is made holy through the brother: if not, your children would be unholy, but now are they holy.

verses.en: But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases: but God hath called us to peace.
verses.pt: Mas, se o incrédulo se apartar, aparte-se; porque neste caso o irmão, ou a irmã, não está sujeito à servidão; pois Deus nos chamou em paz.
verses.en_web: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.
verses.en_bbe: But if the one who is not a Christian has a desire to go away, let it be so: the brother or the sister in such a position is not forced to do one thing or the other: but it is God's pleasure that we may be at peace with one another.

verses.en: For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save thy wife?
verses.pt: Pois, como sabes tu, ó mulher, se salvarás teu marido? ou, como sabes tu, ó marido, se salvarás tua mulher?
verses.en_web: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
verses.en_bbe: For how may you be certain, O wife, that you will not be the cause of salvation to your husband? or you, O husband, that you may not do the same for your wife?

verses.en: But as God hath distributed to every man, as the Lord hath called every one, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all churches.
verses.pt: Somente ande cada um como o Senhor lhe repartiu, cada um como Deus o chamou. E é isso o que ordeno em todas as igrejas.
verses.en_web: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.
verses.en_bbe: Only, as the Lord has given to a man, and as is the purpose of God for him, so let him go on living. And these are my orders for all the churches.

verses.en: Is any man called being circumcised? let him not become uncircumcised. Is any called in uncircumcision? let him not be circumcised.
verses.pt: Foi chamado alguém, estando circuncidado? permaneça assim. Foi alguém chamado na incircuncisão? não se circuncide.
verses.en_web: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.
verses.en_bbe: If any man who is a Christian has had circumcision, let him keep so; and if any man who is a Christian has not had circumcision, let him make no change.

verses.en: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.
verses.pt: A circuncisão nada é, e também a incircuncisão nada é, mas sim a observância dos mandamentos de Deus.
verses.en_web: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.
verses.en_bbe: Circumcision is nothing, and its opposite is nothing, but only doing the orders of God is of value.

verses.en: Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called.
verses.pt: Cada um fique no estado em que foi chamado.
verses.en_web: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.
verses.en_bbe: Let every man keep the position in which he has been placed by God.

verses.en: Art thou called being a servant? care not for it: but if thou mayest be made free, use it rather.
verses.pt: Foste chamado sendo escravo? não te dê cuidado; mas se ainda podes tornar-te livre, aproveita a oportunidade.
verses.en_web: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.
verses.en_bbe: If you were a servant when you became a Christian, let it not be a grief to you; but if you have a chance to become free, make use of it.

verses.en: For he that is called in the Lord, being a servant, is the Lord’s freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Christ’s servant.
verses.pt: Pois aquele que foi chamado no Senhor, mesmo sendo escravo, é um liberto do Senhor; e assim também o que foi chamado sendo livre, escravo é de Cristo.
verses.en_web: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.
verses.en_bbe: For he who was a servant when he became a Christian is the Lord's free man; and he who was free when he became a Christian is the Lord's servant.

verses.en: Ye are bought with a price; be not ye the servants of men.
verses.pt: Por preço fostes comprados; mas vos façais escravos de homens.
verses.en_web: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.
verses.en_bbe: It is the Lord who has made payment for you: be not servants of men.

verses.en: Brethren, let every man, wherein he is called, therein abide with God.
verses.pt: Irmãos, cada um fique diante de Deus no estado em que foi chamado.
verses.en_web: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.
verses.en_bbe: My brothers, let every man keep in that condition which is the purpose of God for him.

verses.en: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful.
verses.pt: Ora, quanto às virgens, não tenho mandamento do Senhor; dou, porém, o meu parecer, como quem tem alcançado misericórdia do Senhor para ser fiel.
verses.en_web: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.
verses.en_bbe: Now about virgins I have no orders from the Lord: but I give my opinion as one to whom the Lord has given mercy to be true to him.

verses.en: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress, I say, that it is good for a man so to be.
verses.pt: Acho, pois, que é bom, por causa da instante necessidade, que a pessoa fique como está.
verses.en_web: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, that it’s good for a man to remain as he is.
verses.en_bbe: In my opinion then, because of the present trouble, it is good for a man to keep as he is.

verses.en: Art thou bound unto a wife? seek not to be loosed. Art thou loosed from a wife? seek not a wife.
verses.pt: Estás ligado a mulher? não procures separação. Estás livre de mulher? não procures casamento.
verses.en_web: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.
verses.en_bbe: If you are married to a wife, make no attempt to get free from her: if you are free from a wife, do not take a wife.

verses.en: But and if thou marry, thou hast not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she hath not sinned. Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh: but I spare you.
verses.pt: Mas, se te casares, não pecaste; e, se a virgem se casar, não pecou. Todavia estes padecerão tribulação na carne e eu quisera poupar-vos.
verses.en_web: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.
verses.en_bbe: If you get married it is not a sin; and if an unmarried woman gets married it is not a sin. But those who do so will have trouble in the flesh. But I will not be hard on you.

verses.en: But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;
verses.pt: Isto, porém, vos digo, irmãos, que o tempo se abrevia; pelo que, doravante, os que têm mulher sejam como se não a tivessem;
verses.en_web: But I say this, brothers: the time is short, that from now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;
verses.en_bbe: But I say this, my brothers, the time is short; and from now it will be wise for those who have wives to be as if they had them not;

verses.en: And they that weep, as though they wept not; and they that rejoice, as though they rejoiced not; and they that buy, as though they possessed not;
verses.pt: os que choram, como se não chorassem; os que folgam, como se não folgassem; os que compram, como se não possuíssem;
verses.en_web: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;
verses.en_bbe: And for those who are in sorrow, to give no signs of it; and for those who are glad, to give no signs of joy; and for those who are getting property, to be as if they had nothing;

verses.en: And they that use this world, as not abusing it: for the fashion of this world passeth away.
verses.pt: e os que usam deste mundo, como se dele não usassem em absoluto, porque a aparência deste mundo passa.
verses.en_web: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.
verses.en_bbe: And for those who make use of the world, not to be using it fully; for this world's way of life will quickly come to an end.

verses.en: But I would have you without carefulness. He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord, how he may please the Lord:
verses.pt: Pois quero que estejais livres de cuidado. Quem não é casado cuida das coisas do Senhor, em como há de agradar ao Senhor,
verses.en_web: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;
verses.en_bbe: But it is my desire for you to be free from cares. The unmarried man gives his mind to the things of the Lord, how he may give pleasure to the Lord:

verses.en: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world, how he may please his wife.
verses.pt: mas quem é casado cuida das coisas do mundo, em como há de agradar a sua mulher,
verses.en_web: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.
verses.en_bbe: But the married man gives his attention to the things of this world, how he may give pleasure to his wife.

verses.en: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.
verses.pt: e está dividido. A mulher não casada e a virgem cuidam das coisas do Senhor para serem santas, tanto no corpo como no espírito; a casada, porém, cuida das coisas do mundo, em como há de agradar ao marido.
verses.en_web: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.
verses.en_bbe: And the wife is not the same as the virgin. The virgin gives her mind to the things of the Lord, so that she may be holy in body and in spirit: but the married woman takes thought for the things of the world, how she may give pleasure to her husband.

verses.en: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.
verses.pt: E digo isto para proveito vosso; não para vos enredar, mas para o que é decente, e a fim de poderdes dedicar-vos ao Senhor sem distração alguma.
verses.en_web: This I say for your own profit; not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.
verses.en_bbe: Now I say this for your profit; not to make things hard for you, but because of what is right, and so that you may be able to give all your attention to the things of the Lord.

verses.en: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.
verses.pt: Mas, se alguém julgar que lhe é desairoso conservar solteira a sua filha donzela, se ela estiver passando da idade de se casar, e se for necessário, faça o que quiser; não peca; casem-se.
verses.en_web: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.
verses.en_bbe: But if, in any man's opinion, he is not doing what is right for his virgin, if she is past her best years, and there is need for it, let him do what seems right to him; it is no sin; let them be married.

verses.en: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but hath power over his own will, and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, doeth well.
verses.pt: Todavia aquele que está firme em seu coração, não tendo necessidade, mas tendo domínio sobre a sua própria vontade, se resolver no seu coração guardar virgem sua filha, fará bem.
verses.en_web: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.
verses.en_bbe: But the man who is strong in mind and purpose, who is not forced but has control over his desires, does well if he comes to the decision to keep her a virgin.

verses.en: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better.
verses.pt: De modo que aquele que dá em casamento a sua filha donzela, faz bem; mas o que não a der, fará melhor.
verses.en_web: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.
verses.en_bbe: So then, he who gets married to his virgin does well, and he who keeps her unmarried does better.

verses.en: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.
verses.pt: A mulher está ligada enquanto o marido vive; mas se falecer o marido, fica livre para casar com quem quiser, contanto que seja no Senhor.
verses.en_web: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: It is right for a wife to be with her husband as long as he is living; but when her husband is dead, she is free to be married to another; but only to a Christian.

verses.en: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of God.
verses.pt: Será, porém, mais feliz se permanecer como está, segundo o meu parecer, e eu penso que também tenho o Espírito de Deus.
verses.en_web: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: But it will be better for her to keep as she is, in my opinion: and it seems to me that I have the Spirit of God.
